thread:
Maya: Quick sync — Product wants to lock launch gates for the Priority Routing initiative. Need cross-team signoff on runtime/infra/security sequencing, canary plan, and explicit rollback criteria. Who can own each area?

Tom: I can own the product side and the launch criteria doc. We need concrete pass/fail checks though. Target launch window: 2 weeks.

Li: For runtime I'll need: model variants pinned, perf SLOs (p95 < 120ms), KV cache migration plan, prewarm/kv-populate strategy, and feature-flag hooks for speedy rollback. :mechanical_arm:

Rob: From infra: capacity plan (GPU SKU + reserved pool), autoscale policy + burst capacity, networking ACLs for private customers, rollout cost estimate. Also need a maintenance window for the initial canary ramps.

Sarah: Security checklist: KMS/HSM integration verified, audit log retention set to 90d for the pilot, secrets rotation documented, and threat model signoff for new routing logic. Also require IR playbook for any data-exfil suspicion.

Maya: Proposed launch criteria (draft):
- Perf: p95 latency <= 120ms on canary traffic (1%) and <= 140ms on 100%
- Reliability: error rate < 1% sustained over 30m
- Cost: incremental cost per 1M tokens <= $X (goal)
- Security: all items in Sarah's checklist must be green
- Observability: tracing + token-level cost breakdown enabled

Tom: Canary plan suggestion: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 30-60m observation windows, automated rollback on error rate spike > 2x baseline or p95 breach. Add a manual hold at 50%.

Li: Agree. We'll use a feature-flag rollout with staged target percentages. Can we use the existing rollout-service? Example flag config:

```
rollout: priority-routing
steps:
  - pct: 1
    duration: 30m
  - pct: 10
    duration: 45m
  - pct: 50
    manual_hold: true
  - pct: 100
```

Rob: I'll provision a reserved pool (8x A5000 equiv) for the first week and set autoscale to cap at 3x baseline. Need approval on budget bump for burst. Also: confirm GPU type — Li, do you have a preference?

Li: A5000 is fine for latency. If we need better perf we can move to A100v5 but costs jump. Let's start A5000 and monitor token/sec.

Sarah: Two security owners assigned: me for KMS/audit, + infra for network segmentation. I'll add checklist items to the launch doc and block release until green.

Maya: Assigning owners: Product -> Tom, Runtime -> Li, Infra -> Rob, Security -> Sarah. Action: each owner to post a 1-paragraph readout in this thread with status by EOD tomorrow.

Tom: I'll update the launch criteria doc and include the rollback thresholds. Will ping legal for compliance note for the private customers.

Rob: I'll open infra PR to provision pool and share cost delta. ETA: tomorrow morning.

Li: I'll prepare runtime smoke tests and a KV-populate job; will post the test plan.

Sarah: I'll run the threat model review and share the checklist result.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout slot reserved: id=cr-2520, scheduled windows set per config.

Maya: Thanks — scheduling a 30m triage Thu 10:00am to confirm all green before canary. If anyone can't make it, reply here.

Tom: I'm in.

Li: In.

Rob: In.

Sarah: In.

Maya: Great — final note: pick a single person to own the rollback runbook (who physically executes the rollback steps). Recommend Rob or Li.

Li: I'll own the rollback steps and the command list.

Maya: Perfect. Summary for thread: owners assigned, rollout plan agreed, security checklist gating release, infra will provision reserved pool, runtime will prepare smoke tests + feature-flag config, product will finalize launch criteria doc. Follow up: post status EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
